summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Intermap Technologies Corporation, a foreign private issuer, to furnish a press release reporting its first quarter 2026 financial results. The press release discusses recurring subscription and data revenue exceeding 80% of total revenue, near break-even operations excluding certain items, and a guided revenue of $30-35 million with a 28% EBITDA margin. There is no mention of any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special-situations event. The filing is purely an earnings release and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
